name: Mechanical Prayer
source:
Mechanical Prayer tells the story of a shy boy called Murdoc, who becomes an angel against his will with the power to read people’s minds. Murdoc is then guided by a mysterious girl called Sona and a fierce mercenary by the name of Ace of Spades, the three go on a dangerous journey to find out what happened to one of the five missing angels, before a new threat called Egregore does.

[From [url=https://gods-of-maa.tumblr.com/tagged/download]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
《Mechanical Prayer》讲述了一个名叫Murdoc的腼腆男孩的故事。他违背自己的意愿变成了天使，并获得了读取他人思想的能力。随后，在神秘女孩Sona与凶悍佣兵“黑桃A”的引领下，三人踏上一段危险旅程，要赶在名为Egregore的新威胁之前，查明五名失踪天使中的一人究竟遭遇了什么。

[来源：[url=https://gods-of-maa.tumblr.com/tagged/download]官方网站[/url]]
